##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 2 triggers (generated by tools/gen_script_v8.py)
##########################################################################

# County scope: a county the realm conquered or holds that is not of a Celtic culture:
# a foreign (non-Gaelic, non-Brythonic) county in Britain, or a Norse-culture county anywhere.
eir_foreign_conquest_county_trigger = {
	OR = {
		eir_foreign_britain_county_trigger = yes
		culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_north_germanic }
	}
}

# Character scope: at least $N$ foreign-held counties in the realm.
eir_foreign_conquests_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		count >= $N$
		eir_foreign_conquest_county_trigger = yes
	}
}

# Character scope: the Black Host has landed and is not yet beaten.
eir_bh_active_trigger = {
	has_global_variable = eir_bh_started
	NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_bh_ended }
}

# Character scope: the player beat the Black Host.
eir_bh_beaten_trigger = {
	has_global_variable = eir_black_host_broken
}

# Character scope: a Norse-culture ruler holds a county in the realm or in de jure Ireland.
eir_norse_presence_trigger = {
	OR = {
		any_sub_realm_county = {
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_north_germanic }
		}
		eir_norse_holds_irish_county_trigger = yes
	}
}

# Character scope: the realm holds a Norse-culture county of its own.
eir_holds_norse_county_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_north_germanic }
	}
}

# Character scope: at least $N$ counties in Britain held by the realm are of a Celtic culture (any origin).
eir_celtic_britain_counties_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		count >= $N$
		title_province ?= { geographical_region = world_europe_west_britannia }
		culture ?= {
			OR = {
				has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic
				has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic
			}
		}
	}
}

# Early game: a ruler with few counties (shows the chieftain-level stories).
eir_small_realm_trigger = {
	NOT = { eir_realm_size_trigger = { N = 8 } }
}

# Character scope: the realm can found the Kingdom of the Island of the Mighty.
eir_can_create_island_kingdom_trigger = {
	highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
	has_global_variable = eir_done_union
	eir_celtic_britain_counties_trigger = { N = 6 }
	any_sub_realm_county = { this = title:c_isle_of_man }
}

# Character scope: the realm holds a coastal county in Great Britain.
eir_holds_british_port_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		is_coastal_county = yes
		OR = {
			kingdom = title:k_england
			kingdom = title:k_scotland
			kingdom = title:k_wales
		}
	}
}

# Character scope: an independent Gaelic ruler lives within reach.
eir_has_gael_neighbour_trigger = {
	any_ruler = {
		is_ai = yes
		is_ruler = yes
		culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic }
		NOT = { this = root }
		NOT = { is_vassal_of = root }
	}
}
